subject: Great meeting at AI Inference Summit — next steps on inference needs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya@visiometrics.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Great meeting at AI Inference Summit — quick follow-up

Hi Priya —

It was great meeting you at the AI Inference Summit last week. I enjoyed the conversation about Visiometrics' real-time video analytics use case and the latency/cost tradeoffs you're evaluating for large-scale deployment.

Quick recap from our quick chat: you’re exploring a hybrid inference strategy (cloud + on-prem edge nodes) to keep per-frame costs down while meeting 95th percentile latency goals. You mentioned a pilot later this quarter to validate end-to-end cost and tail latency.

If it’s helpful I’m happy to put together a short discovery call to capture workload details (batch sizes, average and tail sequence lengths, model families in scope) and share a Mutual Action Plan. Connor (cc'd) is our account lead and can join for timeline/contract discussion.

Are you available for a 30-minute discovery next week? Proposed slots: Wed 6/24 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 6/25 11:00–11:30 PT.

Attaching a short one-pager on Redwood Inference and a sample mutual action plan for pilots.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: redwood-inference-1pager.pdf, mutual-action-plan-visiometrics.xlsx
From: Priya Singh <priya@visiometrics.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@visiometrics.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Great meeting at AI Inference Summit — quick follow-up

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — great to meet you too. Wed 6/24 10:00 PT works for me; Samir (cc) will join from engineering. A bit of context so you can prep: our current production runs a small transformer for object classification at the edge and a larger re-ranking model in the cloud. Pilot goal is to reduce per-frame cost by ~30% and keep 95th percentile latency under 150ms for cloud inference.

Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Priya
Head of ML Engineering | Visiometrics
priay@visiometrics.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya@visiometrics.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Notes & next steps from discovery call (6/24) — Visiometrics pilot

Priya / Samir —

Thanks again for the time today — appreciate the clarity on objectives. Short notes from our discovery and agreed next steps below. Please reply if anything is missing or inaccurate.

Summary:
- Pilot objective: validate hybrid inference approach to reduce per-frame cost by ~30% while meeting 95th percentile latency <150ms for cloud model calls.
- Workloads discussed: average request size ~512 tokens equivalent (video frame embeddings + metadata), bursts up to 200 reqs/sec during events, KV cache reuse expected across short sessions.
- Constraints: data residency for certain customers (US-only), ability to deploy edge inference for specific sites.

Agreed next steps:
1) Redwood: provide a Mutual Action Plan (attached) with success metrics and timeline for a 6–8 week pilot; preliminary cost and instance sizing estimates. Owner: Marissa. Due: 2026-06-28.
2) Redwood SE: technical validation—run perf/latency profile with model family details Samir will share. Owner: David Kim (cc). Due: 2026-07-05.
3) Visiometrics: share sample traffic profile and a sanitized model binary or config for profiler. Owner: Samir. Due: 2026-06-30.

Attachments: discovery-call-notes-20260624.txt, mutual-action-plan-visiometrics.xlsx

Deal ID: RW-2026-457

If that looks good I’ll send the MAP and set up the technical kickoff with David.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Checking in on pilot timeline — Visiometrics / Redwood (RW-2026-457)

Hi Priya —

Wanted to check in on the MAP and the sample traffic that Samir was going to share last week. We’re ready on our side to kick off the technical validation; David has a couple of short profiler scripts that will help us size the pilot accurately.

Is this still a priority for you this quarter? If timelines shifted I can rework the MAP and proposed schedule — no problem either way.

Quick asks (one-line answers are fine):
- Will you be able to share a sample traffic export this week?
- Is the target pilot start still late July?

If useful I can also put together a short ROI appendix showing expected cost delta at scale (based on the traffic numbers you shared on the call).

Best,
Marissa

If priorities have shifted, no worries — would you prefer I check back in after your Q3 planning window? Alternatively we can schedule a 20-minute session with our product team to walk through an expected pilot flow.
